description: Source code implementing ASN.1 structures and methods for private IE IDs and private IE fields in the NRPPa protocol, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Class representing ASN.1 CHOICE for PrivateIE-ID with methods for setting, serialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for ASN.1 SEQUENCE representing PrivateIE-Field with packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for container items holding private IE data, with packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specific option.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to local type and returns reference to c.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to global type.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into bit_ref or cbit_ref.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from bit_ref or cbit_ref.
